guidance: Keep product, brand, protocol, and CLI names listed in doNotTranslate in English.

Preserve every printf/NSString format specifier (%@, %lld, %d, %u, %.1f, %1$@, %2$lld) and escaped literal percent (%%). Positional reordering (%2$@ ... %1$@) is encouraged when natural for the target language, provided every index and conversion type matches English.
Preserve keyboard shortcut symbols (⌘, ⇧, ⌥, ⌃, ⏎), file paths, environment variables, slash commands, and code snippets verbatim.
Keep button labels, menu items, and sidebar titles concise so native controls do not clip or wrap awkwardly.
Match native macOS and Windows platform conventions for the target language rather than translating English idioms word for word.

Task.context: A single coding-agent conversation/work unit in Yardlet's sidebar.

Project.context: A sidebar group backed by one or more local repository folders.

Worktree.context: An isolated Git worktree created for a task.

Harness.context: A local coding-agent CLI backend (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, etc.).

Terminal.context: The integrated terminal surface inside a task.

Browser.context: Yardlet's built-in Chromium browser panel inside a task.

Relay.context: The end-to-end encrypted Yardlet server used to reach a host from outside the local network (often shown as 'Yardlet server' in UI copy).

Connectors.context: External service integrations (MCP servers, Gmail, Calendar, Slack, etc.).

Split View.context: Multiple tasks displayed side by side in panes within one view.

Pane.context: One individual slot inside a Split View.

Turn.context: One user prompt and agent response cycle.

Permission mode.context: Controls whether an agent asks before editing files or running commands.

Thinking level.context: Controls reasoning effort for a model turn.

Subagent.context: A background helper agent launched by a task.

Archive.context: Hide a completed task from the sidebar without deleting its history.

Pin.context: Keep a task or project anchored near the top of the sidebar.

Remote.context: Remote control and pairing between devices (Mac, Windows, Linux, phone).

Paired devices.context: Devices authorized to connect to this host over Remote.

Scheduled tasks.context: Recurring or one-off prompts run automatically on a schedule.

Passwords.context: Yardlet's built-in credential vault for the browser panel.

Workspace.context: The working directory / Codex sandbox scope.

Chats.context: Tasks started without a project folder.
